subject: [PATCH v4 02/11] mm, swap: support zswap and zero-filled swap pages as vswap backends

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch adds support for zswap and zero-filled swap pages as virtual swap (vswap) backends, allowing compressed or zero-filled pages to be stored without pre-allocating physical swap slots. The vswap layer decouples PTE swap entries from physical backing, enabling efficient compression and detection of zero-filled pages. However, this patch only supports zswap and zero-page backends, with physical disk backing and real writeback to be implemented in later patches. Additionally, THP (Transparent Huge Pages) swapin is disabled for vswap entries until further development.
